newsitem.title: LEBANON: Car bomb kills one, wounds two in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb kills one, wounds two in south Lebanon.

text.p: A car bomb exploded on Tuesday in south Lebanon, killing its Lebanese driver and wounding the driver of a nearby car and his wife, Lebanese security sources said.
The pickup truck exploded at 11.30 a.m. (0830 GMT) on a road east of Nabatiyeh, a Shi'ite Moslem market town just outside Israel's south Lebanon border occupation zone, the sources said.
A car behind the pickup was damaged and its driver and his wife, also Lebanese, were injured, the sources added.
Security forces cordoned off the area. A Reuters reporter said the pickup was completely destroyed.
